set.description: The proposed set: a complete cards.sunshine.set record whose cards is empty.

cards.description: The proposed cards, in order, each a complete cards.sunshine.card record with every detail the real card will have. A card is known by its position. Each one's uid is 00000000000000, which can't name a real card because every NXP tag's UID starts with its manufacturer code, 0x04, and its counter is 0. A card's art lives only in the creator's deck until a real card is made from it.

explainer.description: A note to reviewers, in Markdown (CommonMark).

reviewers.description: Who else may see the draft, and which of its cards. Entries add together. Absent, only the deck's owner sees it.

main.description: A proposed set of Sunshine Cards, kept in its creator's deck for chosen reviewers to see before any card is made. The deck's owner always sees all of it.

didReviewer.description: An account that may see every card.

path.description: A RecordPath (https://tangled.org/microcosm.blue/RecordPath) into the card's associated record, like productAccountDid or details.creators[]. A path that doesn't parse grants nothing.

type.description: The $type of the cards' associated records.

recordPathReviewer.description: Lets the accounts a card's own associated record names see that card. It applies to each card whose record's $type is type. Every value path yields from that record that is a DID may see the card; other values are ignored.
